name: Bells
description: Struck and rubbed metal, glass and wood: church bells, singing bowls, vibraphone and chime bars, kalimba, glass and gongs, each a bank of ringing modes at the ratios of the real thing.

params.name: Material
params.description: What is struck: bell, bowl, bar, tine, glass or gong. Each has its own set of overtones. Heard from the next note.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How long the lowest tone of a note rings. The overtones above it die sooner, by an amount Damping sets.

params.name: Damping
params.description: How much faster the high overtones die than the low ones. Low rings like metal; high goes dull quickly, like wood.

params.name: Hardness
params.description: How hard the mallet is. Soft gives a round, muted strike; hard gives a bright attack with more overtones. Heard from the next strike.

params.name: Position
params.description: Where the mallet lands, from the edge or rim to the middle. It changes which overtones the next strike brings out.

params.name: Detune
params.description: Splits each paired overtone into two a little apart in pitch, which makes the ring beat. Higher beats faster; zero is still.

params.name: Stretch
params.description: Squeezes or widens the gaps between the overtones. The middle is the true spacing; lower crowds them towards the note, higher spreads them.

params.name: Sustain
params.description: Rubs the object while a key is held, so its low tones swell and hold instead of dying away. Higher settings also soften the strike.

params.name: Brightness
params.description: Tilts the level of the overtones against the played note. Low is darker and rounder; high brings the upper overtones forward.

params.name: Release
params.description: How quickly a note is damped when its key is let go. At zero it rings on untouched; higher values choke it faster.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Places the overtones across the stereo field. With more of it the beating pairs turn from side to side between the speakers.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Overall output level of the instrument.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Modal synthesis in the tradition of Adrien's Modalys and the MI Elements/Rings resonators in outline only: each mode is a rotating complex one-pole. Mode ratios are textbook and measured values (Rossing, The Science of Percussion Instruments; Fletcher and Rossing; Inacio, Henrique and Antunes on Tibetan bowls), rounded. Not a model of a particular instrument.
